basic_info.description: Welcome to One Mission Bay. Rarely available spacious 1639 sqft, 12th floor exquisite corner 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence with warm southerly sun exposure, partial Bay view and a Juliet balcony. This home features a chef's kitchen with custom kitchen island, Gaggenau appliances, Domus & Domus cabinetry, and Kohler fixtures. Designed by Arquitectonica, this residence blends urban vibrancy with luxurious finishes and resort-style amenities. Enjoy a Harley Pasternak-designed fitness center with a dry sauna, a heated outdoor pool and spa, exhibition and catering kitchens, a library, business center, guest suite, 24-hour lobby attendant service, and one car assigned parking. ONE Mission Bay is ideally located at the crossroads of Mission Creek and Oracle Park, with easy access to Chase Center, King Street shops and restaurants, Safeway, Muni, and public transportation.
